title: Los and Las --- Them, Derived
label: ch:pronoun-plural
canDo: I can make any direct object pronoun plural, and say why the pronoun is tidier than the article.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C45-los-las: produce los tengo and las hago, and explain why lo needed no repair in the plural when el did.
payoff.note: The reader produces both forms in the warm-up before being given them. The etymology pays off a puzzle set two arcs earlier.
